rationale: Computed reactive commands to raise voltages toward 0.98 pu target using linear voltage sensitivity. For each bus, calculated required reactive power from voltage deficit divided by sensitivity, then clipped by aggregate EV inverter apparent-power-derived reactive capability. Bus_2 can fully support the 22.5 kvar needed (capability 25.36 kvar), reaching target. Bus_3 is limited to 13.86 kvar by single EVSE capability, reaching 0.9686 pu.
